name: Forbidden
source:
Shelby, the main character, was trying to rebel against her parents, she is sent to a strange "boarding school" for wealthy families. Hoping to start a new chapter of her life, she'll build new relationships and uncover the dark secrets while roaming the corridors.

[From [url=https://sakuchann.itch.io/forbidden]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主人公谢尔比试图反抗父母，却被送进了一所专供富裕家庭子女就读的古怪“寄宿学校”。她希望开启人生的新篇章，将在这里建立新的关系，并在穿行于走廊的过程中，揭开阴暗的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://sakuchann.itch.io/forbidden]Itch.io[/url]]
